baselines.description: Cold re-derivation: discovery probe + L=3 fresh observation fetches over LEARN_IDS=[11,12,13], distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute -> verify the 5 TASK_IDS=[14,15,16,17,18] via the shipped carrier. The mandate's strong comparator and the ONLY cost/latency denominator. Timed per episode (t_cold_L3) in parity order against the treatment episode; arg deepcopy materialization inside the v4 timed boundary for both arms (placement symmetric, operand asymmetric by construction: reuse deepcopies the full mech dict, cold deepcopies {}; isolated via M-LATENCY-R-L3-NOARG).
baselines.expected_outcome: task success 1.0 (V5 gate >= 0.90); shipped 4-field counter = 19 nominal at L=3 (exact per-episode vector (9,5,5,0); class sums pinned by V-DRIFT-COLD).

baselines.description: Identical to B-COLD but L=2 (LEARN_IDS_MIN=[11,12]), the carrier's minimum viable re-derivation. Mandate decision bar L=2. Timed per episode (t_cold_L2).
baselines.expected_outcome: task success 1.0; shipped 4-field counter = 18 nominal at L=2 (exact vector (8,5,5,0); pinned by V-DRIFT-COLD).

baselines.description: Replay the inherited (unrepaired) parameterized mechanism on the perturbed target. Establishes the perturbation actually bites (V4).
baselines.expected_outcome: success <= 0.10 on every class; if it succeeds the perturbation did not bite -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

baselines.description: Guard detects staleness but the system abstains from repair. Non-executing; NEVER a cost/latency denominator (V6).
Same reuse semantics as T-REPAIR-REUSE plus one carrier rebind (charges +1 retrieval_calls). Upper bound on repair cost; reported sensitivity, excluded from the classifier.
baselines.expected_outcome: shipped counter = reuse + 1 retrieval unit; reported sensitivity only.

baselines.description: Prior system: separate guard probe read before the batch, full task batch re-executed after repair. Must reproduce the prior product-counter regression (V13/H7 premise).
baselines.expected_outcome: shipped counter ratio > 1.00 at L=2 (regression reproduces); failure is a reported validity caveat.

baselines.description: Treatment: freshness check fused into the first task read; after repair the reused probe observation is charged once (one repair_attempts, one repair probe fetch where the class emits one, one post-repair verify); first task id NOT re-resolved/re-fetched/re-verified. Timed per episode (t_reuse) in parity order against cold episodes; v4 timed boundary includes arg deepcopy materialization (full mech-dict operand) and all registry/guard/signal scaffolding.
baselines.expected_outcome: shipped 4-field counter = 17 nominal (exact vectors P1/P3 (6,5,5,1), P2 (5,5,6,1)) vs cold 18/19; deterministic premise V-EQ-HOLDS, episode latency compared empirically, not assumed.

decision_rule: Per class c in {P1-ENDPOINT,P2-STRUCTURE,P3-PERMISSION}, n=12 valid trials. functional_ok := repair_success>=0.80 AND wilson_lower>=0.60 AND contamination<=0.10 AND write_set_max<=1 AND guard_fire>=0.80 (same as parent). V-DRIFT-COLD (in-runner gate, checked before classification): per-class cold shipped sums must equal preregistered nominals exactly (M-SHIPPED-COLD-L2==216==12x18, M-SHIPPED-COLD-L3==228==12x19, M-COLD-HTTP-L2==96==12x8, M-COLD-HTTP-L3==108==12x9); break signals substrate/carrier drift -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (never a negative). The cold path is repair-independent, so this gate cannot mask a repair effect. sp := M-SHIPPED-RATIO-L2<1.00 AND M-SHIPPED-RATIO-L3<1.00 (reported premise V-EQ-HOLDS; deterministic 17/18 and 17/19 by arm protocol on functional_ok trials with zero empirical variance by construction — the AF-3 lesson applied: a drift-checked premise, never an empirical win claim). lw := M-LATENCY-R-L2<1.00 AND M-LATENCY-R-L3<1.00 (median episode-latency ratios under the v4 inclusive timed boundary; the empirical decider that prices all scaffolding in wall-clock). Class verdict first match: FUNCTIONAL-FAIL if !functional_ok; COST-UNKNOWN if any of the four ratios is None; PRICED-WIN if sp AND lw; PRICED-DEFICIT otherwise (an sp deficit without cold drift routes to DROP, never INVALID — the V-EQ swallow is removed). Aggregate first match: any validity gate fails (V0 pin, V1 freeze, V2 isolation, V3 determinism-projection, V4 bite, V5 cold live, V6 inert, V7 guard, V8 leakage, V9 integer counters, V10 not-fitted, V11 n=12, V12 base-liveness, V-DRIFT-COLD, V15 contamination-instrument-live, V-TIMING parity/warmup/finite) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID; any FUNCTIONAL-FAIL -> FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL; any COST-UNKNOWN -> INCONCLUSIVE; all PRICED-WIN -> SUPPORTS; else (any valid PRICED-DEFICIT) -> PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED. Outcome mapping: SUPPORTS->SUPPORTS, PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED->FALSIFIES (bounded product-story drop, NOT a mechanism falsification), FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL->FALSIFIES (bounded functional), MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE->INCONCLUSIVE. Prior predictive distribution (parent 36/36 per-trial latency signs against reuse, gaps 5-25%): PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED is the expected decision-changing outcome; SUPPORTS is arithmetically live but low-prior and is retained so the rule never assumes the answer. Attribution track (answers unknown#1, never gates the priced decision): per class, phase-median deltas reuse-minus-coldL3 with closure |S-MISC|/episode median<=0.20; component X ATTRIBUTED iff its median delta >=0.50 x median episode gap on >=2/3 classes; E<=0 -> ATTRIBUTION-MOOT; closure failure -> ATTRIBUTION-INVALID; else UNATTRIBUTED (honest unknown carried forward). Certificate track (B11 deliverable, independent validity V-CERT): coverage/false-accept census over the frozen 36-trial bank + 36 per-trial fresh-silence probes + 12 held-out guard-only perturbations + 2 NC probes; V-CERT failure invalidates only the certificate, never the priced decision.
estimated_cost: CPU-only, stdlib-only, no downloads, no external API spend. No Stage-A calibration (dropped: unit weights need no fitting). 36 trials x (2 warmup + 7 arms) on an in-process localhost server + NC trials + 12 guard-only held-out probes (fresh app, untimed, seconds) + certificate census reusing scored trials (zero extra timed runs): ~15-50 minutes wall clock, negligible memory. No credential, model, browser or network dependency. B3 model economics unsatisfiable on this substrate by construction; priced in counters only with the blocker recorded.
expected_information_gain: Terminal and decision-changing in both directions; this packet FORCES the re-admission vs permanent-drop resolution the parent left pending. The parent (audit PASS, MIXED-PARTIAL) proved a calibrated-counted surface favors reuse while wall-clock disfavors it, but its calibrated surface was quasi-structurally tainted (repair weight 0.000582 predetermined the win direction, knowable at DESIGN: audit AF-3) and its 0.2-0.9ms excess unattributed. This design (a) replaces the tainted fitted counter with the mandate's shipped 4-field unit counter framed honestly as a drift-checked deterministic premise (V-DRIFT-COLD + V-EQ-HOLDS, zero empirical variance by construction) with the empirical burden on the inclusive-boundary latency surface that prices every scaffolding operation in time, (b) attributes the latency excess across preregistered scaffolding phases with a closure gate, (c) exhibits the honest scaffolding-inclusive 5-field sensitivity, (d) delivers the B11 probe-coverage certificate with independent information beyond the gated bank (36 per-trial fresh-silence probes plus 12 held-out guard-only perturbations on fresh seeds), and (e) terminates under the mandate stop trigger: SUPPORTS re-admits localized repair to the C-PRODUCT-ECON story with honest denominators; any valid deficit permanently drops it with no further L-sweeps. The expected outcome under the parent predictive distribution is PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED with attribution — itself the decision-changing result the mandate stop trigger requires. No existing packet provides the attribution, the certificate, or the terminating rule; the priced comparison itself is continuity (same substrate/carrier/classes/seeds), not a rerun of an equal-weight-only design loop.
falsifier: The mandate's re-admission claim FAILS (no re-admit; permanent bounded drop from the C-PRODUCT-ECON product story) if, with H1 functional/locality gates and V-DRIFT-COLD holding on every class, EITHER the shipped 4-field reuse-vs-cold comparison is >= 1.00 at L=2 OR at L=3 without cold drift (unexpected reuse-side extra ops -> PRICED-DEFICIT), OR the median episode-latency ratio is >= 1.00 at L=2 or L=3 under the v4 inclusive timed boundary (the expected deficit: 0.2-0.9ms unattributed scaffolding excess persists) - i.e. the SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED split persists after scaffolding attribution and the mandate stop trigger converts it to permanent drop. It FAILS differently (FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL, bounded mechanism concern, still no re-admit) if functional/locality soundness itself breaks. It FAILS to decide (MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE, never falsification, no drop) on cold-nominal drift, any insensitive control, broken functional gates, attribution-closure failure affecting the priced surfaces, pin/freeze mismatch, or construction failure. The attribution sub-question resolves to UNATTRIBUTED (honest unknown) rather than falsified if no single component reaches the 0.50 share on >=2 classes with closure holding.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Denominator fixed in advance to B-COLD/B-COLD-MIN (same-carrier cold re-derivation at L=3/L=2) and pinned to exact nominals by V-DRIFT-COLD (216/228 sums, 96/108 http; cold path repair-independent so the pin cannot mask a repair effect); never the abstention control, never a single ratio. Treatment shares carrier/substrate/seeds/perturbations/target-rotation with baselines and differs in physical resolve/fetch/verify/scaffold counts plus wall-clock, evidenced by per-operation logs plus per-phase timings plus scaffold counts (V14). Conservative/legacy arms are reported sensitivities excluded from the classifier (legacy only as V13 replication premise). No counter is tuned: shipped 4-field uses preregistered unit weights with the deterministic-premise framing (AF-3 lesson); scaffold units are preregistered 1:1 counts; the 5-field sensitivity is informational and excluded from the classifier for the stated arithmetic reason (deterministic reuse deficit); latency is raw perf_counter.

control_sensitivity.reason: Distinct non-tautological controls per failure mode, all inherited live from the parent PASS packet on the identical substrate/carrier and re-verified at DESIGN: PC-BASE-LIVENESS scored in-trial; B-LITERAL-REPLAY/B-NO-REPAIR must-fail; NC-NO-PERTURBATION/NC-NOISE must-silent; NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR live (parent 4/4 every trial on this carrier; DESIGN verified the instrument function present and callable, live-fire basis inherited from parent). Specificity is pooled over 36 per-trial fresh-silence probes (read-only guard on unperturbed body, pre-perturb, untimed) plus 2 NCs; sensitivity over the 36-episode bank plus 12 held-out guard-only perturbations on fresh seeds unseen by the gate logic. New gates: V0 substrate pin (v2 hash+bytes re-verified at DESIGN, file tracked in git), V-DRIFT-COLD exact-nominal pin, V-TIMING (2 warmups/trial, exact 6/6 parity per class, finite timings), V-CLOSURE (attribution-track only), V-CERT (certificate-track only). No control is given the treatment answer; certificate ground truth (perturbed=stale by construction, before the guard runs) is independent of the guard. Failure policy INVALID-not-negative throughout.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: The frozen pure classifier was driven with synthetic rows at DESIGN (non-substrate, non-outcome-bearing): all 4 class branches {PRICED-WIN, PRICED-DEFICIT, FUNCTIONAL-FAIL, COST-UNKNOWN} and all 4 aggregates {SUPPORTS, PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED, FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL, INCONCLUSIVE} produced (all True), strict-inequality boundary tested (1.00 is NOT a win), aggregate FUNCTIONAL-FAIL-before-COST-UNKNOWN order matching class order. The AF-3-class determinism is confronted, not repeated: sp is a drift-checked deterministic premise (17/18, 17/19 absent cold drift) and the empirical burden rests on lw (strict inequalities on live wall-clock medians, no floor/ceiling). The V-EQ swallow is removed: V-DRIFT-COLD gates only repair-independent cold nominals, and an sp deficit without cold drift routes to PRICED-DEFICIT/DROP, never INVALID. The 5-field scaffold-inclusive sensitivity stays excluded (nominal 27-28 vs 21-22 deterministic deficit would make SUPPORTS arithmetically unreachable). Honest prior stated: DROP is expected under the parent predictive distribution (36/36 signs, 5-25% gaps); SUPPORTS is arithmetically live but low-prior, retained to avoid assuming the answer; the packet is decision-changing via DROP + attribution + certificate either way.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: Every mutable local code dependency whose identity can change the interpretation is listed and hashed at freeze (4 paths): src/spider/kernel.py (counter/treatment semantics) 3a6caf97..., src/spider/models.py 338aaf4d..., src/spider/registry.py 51fb440d... (all re-verified byte-identical to the parent freeze at DESIGN), plus research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-38244432934/raw_evidence/runner_delta_repair_reuse_v2.py (the runtime-imported parent module: tracked in git, 60855 bytes, d4871091... re-verified at DESIGN; V0 hash+size pin refuses on mismatch at runtime). The executable v4 driver is embedded verbatim in prereg.md section-12 and bound by CANONICAL-RUNNER-V4-SHA256 plus freeze hashes. No external task bank/dataset/fixture is read (substrate, perturbation bank, fresh-silence probes, held-out bank and certificate bank all built in-runner from pinned seeds). List complete.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: All hard prerequisites verified at DESIGN without confirmatory measurement: Python 3.12 stdlib (3.12.15, timer 1ns); carrier imports and executes (hashes match parent freeze); v2 pin checked (60855 bytes d487..., tracked file, all 31 v2-module attributes used by the v4 driver verified present by static name check at DESIGN); DESIGN fresh-path liveness (unperturbed server/distill/resolve/fetch/verify/guard-silent/registry-RW, booleans only, discarded; no perturbation, no repair comparison, no timings recorded) plus the pinned-module synthetic repair-signal probe (patched True P1/P2/P3); perturbation bank enumerable from pinned v2 (3 LOCAL classes, rotating targets, fixed seed scheme; held-out seeds SEED4+50000 disjoint). Fresh-silence and held-out probes use only already-exercised v2 calls with identical signatures (Arm/resolve/netfetch/guard/flatten/target_mech/set_perturb) in untimed read-only sections, adding no new failure mode to timed episodes. No external bank/dataset/fixture/model endpoint needed. B3 model endpoint absent by construction (structural zeros preregistered, blocker recorded). Nothing assumed.

treatment_liveness.reason: Treatment uses the shipped carrier that parent packets executed end-to-end (distill_parameterized -> resolve EXECUTABLE -> fetch 200 -> verify True; repair-signal path produces patches; DESIGN re-verified via the pinned-module synthetic probe (patched True on all three classes, non-bank synthetic seed) plus fresh-path end-to-end re-exercise (distill to guard-silent); scored-bank repair liveness (36/36) inherited from the parent PASS packet on the byte-identical carrier, not re-executed at DESIGN). The v4 runner calls the same pinned v2 arm functions with added non-semantic instrumentation (timers/counters); instrumentation adds no new failure mode to the treatment path (wrapping only). Success rates at the 1.0 ceiling are functional gates, not the measured advantage: the empirical dynamic range is the continuous latency surface (parent medians 4.3-4.7ms vs 3.8-4.3ms, gaps 0.2-0.9ms, timer 1ns) plus phase attribution. No structural barrier to EXECUTABLE.

hypothesis: H1 (functional/locality gates, re-attested): after a single LOCAL perturbation, reuse-based signal-driven local repair restores success on ALL FIVE TASK_IDS at rate >= 0.80 per class (Wilson lower >= 0.60), guard fires >= 0.80, write_set_max <= 1, same-target contamination <= 0.10, overbroad control fires > 0.10. H2 (shipped counter, deterministic drift-checked premise): under the mandate's shipped 4-field unit counter (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts, unit weights, zero fitted quantities), reuse charges exactly 17 units vs cold 18/19 by arm protocol on every functional_ok trial (parent vectors P1/P3 (6,5,5,1), P2 (5,5,6,1) vs cold (8,5,5,0)/(9,5,5,0)); H2 has zero empirical variance by construction and is checked as V-DRIFT-COLD (repair-independent cold nominals) + V-EQ-HOLDS, never claimed as an empirical win (AF-3 lesson). H3 (end-to-end latency, the empirical decider): median timed-episode latency ratio reuse/cold is STRICTLY below 1.00 at BOTH L=2 and L=3 under the v4 inclusive timed boundary. H4 (attribution): the reuse latency excess (if any) is attributable to preregistered scaffolding phases (S-REGISTRY-BUILD/SCAN/WRITE, S-GUARD, S-REPAIR-SIGNAL, S-ARG, S-EXECUTE, S-DISTILL) with phase-closure |S-MISC|/episode median <= 0.20 per class; the top component covers >= 0.50 of the median episode gap on >= 2/3 classes. H5 (B3): model_calls/model_tokens are structurally 0 (no LLM endpoint on substrate); real model-call/token economics is UNSATISFIABLE here, priced in counters only, blocker recorded. H6 (certificate): the guard probe-coverage certificate over the frozen 36-trial bank + 36 per-trial fresh-silence probes + 12 held-out guard-only perturbations + 2 NC probes is complete (V-CERT): bank/held-out sensitivity, pooled specificity, exact false-accept counts, residual budget-sparse boundary explicitly enumerated with measured-vs-derived labels. H7 (replication premise): T-REPAIR-LEGACY still reproduces the prior regression (shipped ratio > 1.00 at L=2).
measurement_validity: V0-SUBSTRATE-PIN: the immutable parent v2 runner file must hash to d4871091dc5bf9aa21d918f2577612aa8c5762e314033d0bbbee46b4962bc608 (60855 bytes) before import; mismatch aborts (refuse-to-run), never a result.
V1-FREEZE_BINDING: the v4 driver extracted by splitting prereg.md section-12 markers hashes to CANONICAL-RUNNER-V4-SHA256; request/spec/prereg/carrier hashes match freeze.json.

V2-SUBSTRATE_ISOLATION: Python 3.12 stdlib only (ThreadingHTTPServer, localhost ephemeral port); no LLM, credential, external network, browser; therefore model_calls/model_tokens are structurally 0 and fetches are the scarce accounting resource.

V3-DETERMINISM-PROJECTION: fixed seeds (SEED4=3980394806; per-trial seeds derived as SEED4+1000*(ci+1)+j; held-out seeds SEED4+50000+1000*(ci+1)+k, disjoint; bootstrap seeds derived); the discrete/counter projection (success, counters, oplogs, order flags, validity flags, scaffold counts, phase timings) is recorded for audit recomputation; latency is wall-clock and NOT projected as deterministic.
V4-PERTURBATION_BITES: B-LITERAL-REPLAY success <= 0.10 every class.
V5-COLD_BASELINE_LIVE: B-COLD success >= 0.90 every class.
V6-NO_REPAIR_INERT: B-NO-REPAIR success <= 0.10; never a denominator.
V7-GUARD_LIVENESS: guard fires >= 0.80 on perturbed bank trials AND NOT on NC-NO-PERTURBATION/NC-NOISE; held-out sensitivity reported separately (not gated).
V8-NO_TARGET_LEAKAGE: repair writes exactly one mechanism (write_set_max <= 1); contamination measured only on genuinely unaffected resources with the in-support probe (id=14).

V9-INTEGER_COUNTERS: cost counters are integer counts from the shipped TrajectoryCounters surface plus preregistered integer scaffold units; latency is perf_counter seconds; no estimated, fitted, or model-token quantities.

V10-THRESHOLD_NOT_FITTED: all bars, bootstrap B_LAT=2000, N=12, scaffold unit definitions/parity, phase list, held-out size/seeds, nominal vectors, and attribution thresholds were preregistered before any scored run; NO calibration workload exists in v4 (the parent Stage-A fitter is deliberately removed: unit weights need no fitting); the 5-field sensitivity weight (1:1 parity) is preregistered and informational only.

V11-N_CONTROLLED: TRIALS_PER_CLASS=12 with rotating targets; 2 warmups per trial excluded; certificate bank = the exact 36 scored perturbations + 36 per-trial fresh-silence probes + 12 held-out guard-only probes (4/class, fresh seeds, untimed, unscored for pricing) + 2 NC probes.
V12-POSITIVE_CONTROL: PC-BASE-LIVENESS true inside EVERY valid scored trial.
V13-LEGACY_REPRODUCTION: T-REPAIR-LEGACY shipped ratio > 1.00 at L=2; failure is a reported validity caveat (diagnostic premise, not a gate).

V14-REUSE_IDENTITY: treatment, conservative, legacy share seeds/perturbations/substrate/baseline with the cold arms in-trial; per-operation logs plus per-phase timings differ only in preregistered scaffolding; oplogs present every trial.
V15-CONTAMINATION-INSTRUMENT-LIVE: probes total > 0 AND overbroad rate > 0.10; else MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

V-DRIFT-COLD: per-class cold shipped sums must equal preregistered nominals exactly (M-SHIPPED-COLD-L2==216==12x18, M-SHIPPED-COLD-L3==228==12x19, M-COLD-HTTP-L2==96==12x8, M-COLD-HTTP-L3==108==12x9); break signals substrate/carrier drift -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (never a negative). The cold path is repair-independent, so this gate cannot mask a repair effect.

V-EQ-PREMISE (reported, not a gate): shipped reuse-vs-cold inequality (reuse<cold at L2 AND L3, fetch_L3<=0.90) recorded as V-EQ-HOLDS; deterministic 17/18 and 17/19 by arm protocol on functional_ok trials (AF-3 lesson: premise, not empirical win). An sp deficit without cold drift routes to PRICED-DEFICIT/DROP, never INVALID.

V-TIMING: 2 warmups per trial (72 total); per-class parity order exactly 6 rep-first/6 cold-first; zero timed-episode errors; all episode latencies finite > 0; v4 inclusive boundary (arg deepcopy inside timing; placement symmetric, operand asymmetric by construction: reuse deepcopies the full mech dict, cold deepcopies {}) primary with v3-exact boundary (S-ARG excluded, M-LATENCY-R-L3-NOARG) as sensitivity.
V-CLOSURE (attribution track only): median |S-MISC|/episode <= 0.20 per class; failure invalidates only the attribution answer (UNATTRIBUTED/ATTRIBUTION-INVALID), never the priced decision.

V-CERT (certificate track only): bank fully enumerated pre-run (36 scored + 36 fresh-silence + 12 held-out + 2 NC); every item scored exactly once with guard verdict + construction ground truth recorded; residual boundary enumerated with measured-vs-derived labels; failure invalidates only the certificate deliverable, never the priced decision.

Representation loss: simplified JSON API, not real websites; conclusions bounded to this substrate/carrier/classes/counters; model-call economics unmeasured by construction (B3 UNSATISFIABLE, carried as blocked-unknown); bytes reported diagnostic only.

Scope bound: does not execute the gated C-PRODUCT-ECON flagship; mutates no cross-lane claim status; produces terminal decision inputs for the Runtime DIRECTOR and Global Research Director; certificate schema co-owned with product for B11.

null_control.failure_policy: Any false-firing guard -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Insensitive overbroad -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (the parent F1 failure must not recur). Cold-nominal drift -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (substrate changed, never a scientific negative). V-CLOSURE failure -> attribution INVALID only. V-CERT failure -> certificate INVALID only.
null_control.protocol: NC-NO-PERTURBATION: guard on unperturbed body must be fresh (stale=false). NC-NOISE: observed_at churn must not fire. Per-trial fresh-silence: read-only guard on the unperturbed body in EVERY trial pre-perturbation (36 probes, untimed). Held-out: 12 guard-only probes on fresh perturbations (fresh seeds, untimed). NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR: target repaired postconditions applied to ALL mechanisms; in-support probe on 4 unaffected resources must flag breakage (>0.10). V-CLOSURE: sum of preregistered phase timings must reconstruct each timed episode within 20% (median per class). V-CERT: bank (36) + fresh-silence (36) + held-out (12) + NCs (2) fully enumerated and singly scored with construction ground truth.
null_control.success_criterion: NC-NO-PERTURBATION stale=false AND NC-NOISE stale=false AND pooled fresh-silence specificity recorded; overbroad rate > 0.10 with probes>0; closure medians <= 0.20; certificate bank complete (36/36/12/2 known).

members.protocol: Inside every scored trial: boot substrate, distill from LEARN_IDS via shipped distill_parameterized, then for each of five resources resolve+fetch+verify in-support probe id 14 against the live server BEFORE perturbation.
members.success_criterion: all five return (200, id, verified=True); base_liveness=true for the trial.

members.protocol: Non-outcome-bearing DESIGN probes: v2 pin + carrier-hash verification, module import, fresh-path liveness (server/distill/resolve-EXECUTABLE/fetch-200/verify-True/guard-silent/registry-RW booleans, unperturbed, discarded), pinned-module synthetic repair-signal probe (patched True on P1/P2/P3 synthetic inputs, non-bank seed), timer check, pure synthetic classifier reachability, v2 API-existence check for all 31 used v2-module attributes, nominal-vector arithmetic (12x17/18/19).
members.success_criterion: server path importable, pin verified, carrier hashes match parent freeze, timer 1ns, fresh path executes end-to-end with guard silent, repair signal patches on all classes, all 4+4 classifier branches reachable, cold nominals exact.

positive_control.success_criterion: pre-perturbation, in EVERY scored trial, all five learned mechanisms resolve EXECUTABLE and verify on the in-support probe (base_liveness=true); aggregate true-trials == total. Attestation inside the scored artifact.

product_consequence_negative: Any valid non-win (PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED: shipped counter deficit without cold drift or latency deficit at L=2 or L=3 on any class; FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL: broken functional/locality soundness) PERMANENTLY DROPS reuse-based localized repair from the C-PRODUCT-ECON product story on this substrate/carrier/classes/counter, with no further L-sweeps (mandate stop trigger fires here, resolving the parent AF-7 ambiguity for this packet: this negative IS a permanent drop, unlike the parent's drop-pending ruling). C-DELTA-REPAIR itself is NOT rejected and stays EXPERIMENTAL bounded to functional/locality soundness (repair works; it just does not pay end-to-end). No promotion. The B3 blocker (no model economics) and the certificate boundary are carried as explicit unknowns, not as drop rationale.
product_consequence_positive: SUPPORTS (shipped 4-field premise holds at L=2 AND L=3 AND median latency strictly below cold at L=2 AND L=3, all classes, valid gates) RE-ADMITS reuse-based localized repair to the C-PRODUCT-ECON product story WITH honest denominators (shipped unit counter + inclusive-boundary latency + scaffold attribution + B11 certificate with held-out sensitivity). No code promotion (runtime lane; no kernel change; carrier byte-identical). B3 real model-call/token economics remains an explicit recorded blocker for any flagship product-economics claim.
question: Which uncounted episode-scaffolding component accounts for the ~0.2-0.9ms reuse latency excess, and under a shipped scaffolding-priced end-to-end counter (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts, plus a measured probe-coverage certificate or runtime observation guard for the B11 budget-sparse boundary as the second deliverable), is reuse-based localized repair strictly cheaper than cold re-derivation at L=2 and L=3 - i.e. does the SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED split resolve toward re-admission or permanent drop from the C-PRODUCT-ECON product story? (B3 model economics unsatisfiable here: priced in counters only, blocker recorded.)
title: Scaffolding-attributed, scaffolding-priced terminal comparison for delta-repair with B11 certificate
